options.name: api_timeout
options.description: How long should the socket layer wait before timing out for API calls. If this is omitted, nothing will be passed to the requests library.

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary containing auth information as needed by the cloud's auth plugin strategy. For the default I(password) plugin, this would contain I(auth_url), I(username), I(password), I(project_name) and any information about domains (for example, I(user_domain_name) or I(project_domain_name)) if the cloud supports them. For other plugins, this param will need to contain whatever parameters that auth plugin requires. This parameter is not needed if a named cloud is provided or OpenStack OS_* environ

options.name: auth_type
options.description: Name of the auth plugin to use. If the cloud uses something other than password authentication, the name of the plugin should be indicated here and the contents of the I(auth) parameter should be updated accordingly.

options.name: backup_gigabytes
options.description: Maximum size of backups in GB's.

options.name: backups
options.description: Maximum number of backups allowed.

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: A path to a CA Cert bundle that can be used as part of verifying SSL API requests.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: A path to a client certificate to use as part of the SSL transaction.

options.name: client_key
options.description: A path to a client key to use as part of the SSL transaction.

options.name: cloud
options.description: Named cloud or cloud config to operate against. If I(cloud) is a string, it references a named cloud config as defined in an OpenStack clouds.yaml file. Provides default values for I(auth) and I(auth_type). This parameter is not needed if I(auth) is provided or if OpenStack OS_* environment variables are present. If I(cloud) is a dict, it contains a complete cloud configuration like would be in a section of clouds.yaml.

options.name: cores
options.description: Maximum number of CPU's per project.

options.name: fixed_ips
options.description: Number of fixed IP's to allow. Available until Nova API version 2.35.

options.name: floating_ips
options.description: Number of floating IP's to allow.

options.name: gigabytes
options.description: Maximum volume storage allowed for project.

options.name: groups
options.description: Number of groups that are allowed for the project

options.name: health_monitors
options.description: Maximum number of health monitors that can be created.

options.name: injected_file_content_bytes
options.description: Maximum file size in bytes. Available until Nova API version 2.56.

options.name: injected_file_path_bytes
options.description: Maximum path size. Available until Nova API version 2.56.

options.name: injected_files
options.description: Number of injected files to allow. Available until Nova API version 2.56.

options.name: instances
options.description: Maximum number of instances allowed.

options.name: interface
options.description: Endpoint URL type to fetch from the service catalog.

options.name: key_pairs
options.description: Number of key pairs to allow.

options.name: l7_policies
options.description: The maximum amount of L7 policies you can create.

options.name: l7_rules
options.description: The maximum amount of L7 rules you can create.

options.name: listeners
options.description: The maximum number of listeners you can create.

options.name: load_balancers
options.description: The maximum amount of load balancers you can create

options.name: members
options.description: Number of members allowed for loadbalancer.

options.name: metadata_items
options.description: Number of metadata items allowed per instance.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the OpenStack Project to manage.

options.name: networks
options.description: Number of networks to allow.

options.name: per_volume_gigabytes
options.description: Maximum size in GB's of individual volumes.

options.name: pools
options.description: The maximum number of pools you can create

options.name: ports
options.description: Number of Network ports to allow, this needs to be greater than the instances limit.

options.name: ram
options.description: Maximum amount of ram in MB to allow.

options.name: rbac_policies
options.description: Number of policies to allow.

options.name: region_name
options.description: Name of the region.

options.name: routers
options.description: Number of routers to allow.

options.name: sdk_log_level
options.description: Log level of the OpenStackSDK

options.name: sdk_log_path
options.description: Path to the logfile of the OpenStackSDK. If empty no log is written

options.name: security_group_rules
options.description: Number of rules per security group to allow.

options.name: security_groups
options.description: Number of security groups to allow.

options.name: server_group_members
options.description: Number of server group members to allow.

options.name: server_groups
options.description: Number of server groups to allow.

options.name: snapshots
options.description: Number of snapshots to allow.

options.name: state
options.description: A value of C(present) sets the quota and a value of C(absent) resets the quota to defaults.

options.name: subnet_pools
options.description: Number of subnet pools to allow.

options.name: subnets
options.description: Number of subnets to allow.

options.name: timeout
options.description: How long should ansible wait for the requested resource.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not SSL API requests should be verified. Before Ansible 2.3 this defaulted to C(true).

options.name: volumes
options.description: Number of volumes to allow.

options.name: wait
options.description: Should ansible wait until the requested resource is complete.
